We need to determine charges based on facts. Primary charge likely "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票". The case involves virtual invoices for tax deduction (抵扣税款发票). So primary charge: 虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票. Actually they are virtual import tax payment certificates, used to claim tax deduction. So yes.

Companion charges list: - 经济犯 (co-occurred 1x) - 逃税 (co-occurred 1x) - 隐匿、故意销毁会计凭证、会计帐簿、财务会计报告 (co-occurred 1x)

We need to include each ONLY if case facts support it.

Check facts: They did virtual invoices, false import tax payment certificates, claimed tax deduction. Did they also evade tax? They claimed deduction of 1,137,692.31 + 1,557,316.24 = about 2.7 million. They didn't pay tax? They claimed deduction, but the certificates were fake, so they effectively evaded tax. That could be 逃税 (tax evasion). The case mentions no tax loss? Actually they claimed deduction, but the tax authority may have given deduction? It says they submitted to county tax bureau and got deduction. It says "截至目前亦没有补交税款". So they have not repaid tax. So tax evasion present.

Economic crime (经济犯) is a broader category for economic offenses like fraud, tax crimes, etc. Usually includes tax evasion, fraud, etc. Might be applicable. But we need to see if case facts explicitly support "经济犯". The list of companion charges are co-occurring in training; we include only if facts support. The facts involve tax fraud, false capital increase, misappropriation of funds. That is economic crime. So we can include 经济犯.

Hidden/destroy accounting records? No mention of destroying accounting documents. So not include.

Thus charges: primary: 虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票; plus 逃税; plus 经济犯.

Check if "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票" is correct label. In examples, they used that exact phrase. Yes.

Thus final answer list: 虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票;逃税;经济犯
